title: Borel Gram representative γ(w) = A(A*A)⁻¹∇h(w) ∈ range A of a differential along an injective C¹ chart differential A = DΦ(w)
statement: Let P, n ∈ ℕ (ℝᵏ = EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin k) with inner product ⟨·,·⟩), let Ω ⊆ ℝⁿ be open, let Φ : ℝⁿ → ℝ^P be of class C¹ such that DΦ(w) := fderiv ℝ Φ w is injective for every w ∈ Ω, and let h : ℝⁿ → ℝ be an arbitrary function, with Dh(w) := fderiv ℝ h w (Mathlib's Fréchet derivative, 0 where h is not differentiable). Then there is a Borel measurable γ : ℝⁿ → ℝ^P such that for every w ∈ Ω: γ(w) ∈ DΦ(w)(ℝⁿ) = LinearMap.range (fderiv ℝ Φ w), and ⟨γ(w), DΦ(w)u⟩ = Dh(w)u for every u ∈ ℝⁿ.
lean_statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (Φ : Eucl n → Eucl P) (Ω : Set (Eucl n)) (h : Eucl n → ℝ), IsOpen Ω → ContDiff ℝ 1 Φ → (∀ w ∈ Ω, Function.Injective (fderiv ℝ Φ w)) → ∃ γ : Eucl n → Eucl P, Measurable γ ∧ ∀ w ∈ Ω, γ w ∈ LinearMap.range (fderiv ℝ Φ w).toLinearMap ∧ ∀ u : Eucl n, inner ℝ (γ w) (fderiv ℝ Φ w u) = fderiv ℝ h w u
